question: Confirm the proposed package/runtime profile and resolve a compatible lockfile. The archived constitution says Laravel 12; the pinned starter declares Laravel 13.17+ and PHPUnit, not Pest.

Accept or revise the proposed atomic completion boundary: number, bill, deposits, receivables, ledger, audit and outbox commit together. Doctor accrual and remote delivery are durable asynchronous reactions.

Can further charges arrive after finalization? Choose one-final-per-encounter versus supplemental bills, and the close/reopen policy. Proposed: check and lock a charge-set revision; reject a stale request without consuming a number.
Specify sub-paise tax tie handling, payer allocation of the document rounding adjustment, and tax/discount/package ordering. Integer paise alone does not settle these.
Source OQ-03 leaves in-patient pharmacy exemption unsettled. Preserve a versioned policy parameter; applicable policy needs review before these outcomes are accepted.
When IRP is required, may a patient document be released before the IRN? How is a later IRN attached while amounts remain immutable? What backs dynamic QR generation?
Select provider bindings and demonstrate dedupe/reconciliation for ambiguous SMS, WhatsApp, email and OTP outcomes. Source promises no duplicate messages; local queue retries alone cannot prove that.

Bind real encounter, patient/contact, charge, payer/discount, deposit, doctor-rule and facility-config stores. Seeds/fakes prove adapters only; original archive is planning data, not a working hospital app.
Define reference load, database/hardware, concurrent tenants/requests and test duration for the 2,000-line p95 <= 5 seconds target.
